supported_scope: SKILL.md skills discovered at workspace (.agents/skills/), global (~/.gemini/antigravity-cli/skills/) and plugin locations; each skill becomes a slash command in the TUI; plugins package and share skills through agy plugin.
unestablished_scope: Skill versioning other than through plugin versions
required_setup: Author or install a skill; none is added to this profile.

evidence.quote: The Antigravity CLI features full support for local and global agent skills
